mintAuthority.summary: GHO has economically unbounded native issuance authority. Core/Lido/Horizon mintAndSupply prefunds a fixed first-hop pool on behalf of the minter, not a caller-chosen recipient; downstream lending/configuration/upgrade reach is not fully closed. The independent 2-of-3 Risk Council retains deposit-free, chosen-recipient GSMs Mainnet mint and maximum 2x Bucket Steward increases per facilitator after strictly more than 86400 seconds. That repeat cooldown is not public notice or a finite lifetime budget: the Council route remains zero-delay and independent of governance. The reviewed ordinary Level-1 payload-visible lower bound is 345603 seconds (1 + 259201 + 86401); global closure and D32 voting census remain incomplete. GHO retains its adverse mint posture; no active mint compromise is alleged. Removing the Council's chosen-recipient mint permission, restricting that mint to the reserve, or imposing a finite aggregate token-governed budget would let ordinary D29 assess GHO, subject to complete execution, authority and D32 voting evidence. None of these changes is established by this review.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800 (2026-10-01), canonical GHO bytecode matched the verified GhoToken deployment and its EIP-1967 implementation and correct admin slots were zero. The ACL Admin executor retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE. getFacilitatorsList() returned eight registered facilitators and totalSupply() returned 699,000,000 GHO; the Arbitrum and Monad GSM facilitators each had 50,000,000 GHO capacity and level. The token's verified mint function enforces each facilitator's bucket capacity, while DAO-authorized administration can add facilitators or raise capacities. The separately verified GHO Bucket Steward also holds BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE and can increase approved native facilitator capacities under its own Risk Council and debounce checks. Contract-governed issuance has no off-chain reserve reconciliation requirement; no prudential supervision of this native mint boundary is evidenced in the reviewed protocol disclosures. D14/D29 review on 2026-10-03 reuses the successful executor addFacilitator(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead,"parity",uint128.max) simulation at Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a). GhoToken.mint checks facilitator bucket capacity/level, not collateral or code identity, so the economic cap is unbounded. At the same pin, getFacilitatorsList and every getFacilitatorBucket confirm all eight existing capacities/levels. Bucket Steward.getControlledFacilitators returns Core 0x5513224daaeabca31af5280727878d52097afa05, Horizon 0xe10c78a3ac7f016ed2de1a89c5479b1039eab9ea, mainnet GSMs 0xe9ac5231faecb633da0fe85fcb2785b8363427d2 and Lido 0x2ce01c87fec1b71a9041c52caed46fc5f4807285. Pinned EIP-1967 slots and exact source/runtime matches bind the three pool minters to their verified GhoDirectMinter implementations; mintAndSupply mints first and deposits the newly minted GHO into the pool, rather than checking a new borrower collateral deposit at this boundary. Their owner is the executor and guardian is the Risk Council. Critically, mainnet GSMs is verified GhoDirectFacilitator, not a deposit-checking GSM contract: mint(account,amount) checks only MINTER_ROLE. Full grant/revoke history plus hasRole reads identify both executor and Risk Council as live MINTER_ROLE holders there. Council is a 2/3 Safe; its pinned eth_call raising that bucket from 310M to 311M succeeds immediately. Thus Council can increase capacity and cause durable arbitrary-recipient issuance without collateral, defeating the delegated-collateral-only and governor-only gates. Its one-day debounce limits repeat updates, not the unavoidable delay before an eligible new update; the Council issuance path minimum is 0 seconds. O0 source/state refresh at Ethereum block 26118754 (hash 0x46fd43392d650fe2bc04e7c1549d6982a476b9e11d4aa0996323c90f6328ab10, 2026-10-04T11:41:11Z) corrects ordinary Level-1 public payload visibility to 345603 seconds: 1 second publication-to-activation, 259201 seconds activation-to-accepted-result, and 86401 seconds queued-payload-to-execution. Pre-payload proposal cooldown is excluded; COOLDOWN_PERIOD is zero. Exact pinned selectors/source inequalities are cited in executionCertificates proof gho-ordinary-route. Cross-chain transport may add latency but is not a certified lower-bound component. Ethereum 26118754 Governance.getVotingConfig(1) 0x1c84e321 returns yesThreshold 320000, yesNoDifferential 80000 and minPropositionPower 80000. Source PRECISION_DIVIDER is 1e18; _isPassingYesThreshold requires forVotes > 320000e18 and _isPassingYesNoDifferential requires forVotes - againstVotes > 80000e18.
